violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the bathroom was lacking signage. PIC created during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/22/2023

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
